dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product runs a flow in a fixed order of steps — a checkout, a set-up, an application — and shows the person where they are in it: which step is current, which are done, which has an error, which are still to come, with the done steps pressable to go back. It shows it as a row above the content on a wide screen, as a column beside it, and as "Step 2 of 5" on a narrow one.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a stepper reads: the marker's size, corners, ring width, number style, glyph size and weight, and the gap to the text; a step's corners and padding and the least width of a column; the label's and the description's text styles and the gap between them; the connector's colors, thickness and distance from the markers; the compact form's bar (colors, thickness, gap, corners) and its position line (style, color, gap); the motion; and for each condition (incomplete, current, complete, error) the colors of a step's fill, marker fill, ring, marker content, label, description and state layer, at rest and in each state.
rules: A stepper shows where a person is in a flow the product runs: one step is current, the steps before it are complete, one may have an error. A procedure to read, with no position, is Steps, not this.

Each condition differs by more than color: current is a filled marker with the number, complete a check, error the glyph priority_high, incomplete a ring with the number. Keep those differences when restyling: never make two conditions differ by hue alone.

The current step's marker fill (current.marker.color) and the incomplete ring (incomplete.marker.outline.color) carry the condition to the eye and must stand 3:1 against the surface; the complete fill may be quiet because its check identifies it.
connector.complete.color is the line after a complete step, so the way already gone is one line; connector.color the rest.
step.min-width decides when a horizontal stepper turns compact: the number of steps times it is the least width that holds every step.
Each condition's state-layer.color is the color hover, focus and press mix into a pressable step; it aliases that condition's label color.
marker.size is a minimum: the marker grows with enlarged text.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a marker or a connector by hand.

size.$description: The marker's least height and width: a circle that holds a two-digit number or a glyph of marker.icon.size with room around it. A minimum: it grows with enlarged text.

shape.$description: The marker's corners: a circle in the default system. Never larger than half the marker's height.

width.$description: The ring's width, drawn inside the marker's size. Thicker than the hairline of Steps' rings, because here the ring says a condition.

typescale.$description: The text style of the step's number in the marker.

size.$description: The box of the check and of priority_high in a marker.

weight.$description: The stroke weight of the marker's glyphs: a control's own mark, drawn at the mark weight as a checkbox's check is, not at sys.icon.weight.

gap.$description: The space between the marker and the step's text: under the marker in the horizontal form, beside it in the vertical form.

shape.$description: The corners of a step's container, where hover, focus and press are drawn, and of its focus ring.

padding.$description: The space between a step's container edge and its marker and text, on every side. Two steps' paddings are the space between them.

dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product with long step names turns compact sooner than one whose steps are named in a word; another keeps five steps in a row on a narrow column.

min-width.$description: The least width of a step's column in the horizontal form. Where the layout gives the stepper less than the number of steps times this, a horizontal stepper draws its compact form.

typescale.$description: The text style of a step's label, the same in every condition, so that no step moves when the current step does.
The text style of a step's description, under its label.

gap.$description: The space between a step's label and its description.

color.$description: The line from a step's marker to the next, after a step that is not complete: the system's hairline color. Decorative.
The line after a complete step: the way already gone, drawn in the current marker's color. Decorative.

thickness.$description: The connector's thickness. Zero draws no connector.

gap.$description: The space the connector keeps from the marker it leaves and from the marker it reaches.

color.$description: The compact form's segments after the current step. Decorative: the position says the same in words.
The compact form's segments of the current step and every step before it.

thickness.$description: The thickness of a segment of the compact form's bar.

gap.$description: The space between two segments of the bar.

shape.$description: The corners of a segment of the bar.

typescale.$description: The text style of the compact form's position ("Step 2 of 5").

color.$description: The color of the compact form's position: secondary text.

gap.$description: The space between the compact form's bar and its position line.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A step has no fill at rest; the surface behind it shows through.

color.$description: A step's fill. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn on a pressable step.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The marker of this condition is a ring with no fill.

color.$description: The marker of a step still to come: no fill, a ring.
The ring of a step still to come: the input's edge color, held to 3:1, because it is the marker's only mark besides its number.
The number in the marker of a step still to come.
The label of a step still to come: secondary text.
The description of a step still to come.
The color hover, focus and press mix into a pressable step's container: its label's.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A step has no fill at rest; the surface behind it shows through.

color.$description: A step's fill. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn on a pressable step.
The marker of the current step: filled, the strongest mark of the row.
The current marker's ring: its fill's color.
The number on the current marker's fill.
The current step's label.
The current step's description.
The color hover, focus and press mix into a pressable step's container: its label's.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A step has no fill at rest; the surface behind it shows through.

color.$description: A step's fill. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn on a pressable step.
The marker of a complete step: a quiet fill under its check, so that the current step stays the strongest mark.
A complete marker's ring: its fill's color.
The check on a complete marker.
A complete step's label.
A complete step's description.
The color hover, focus and press mix into a pressable step's container: its label's.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A step has no fill at rest; the surface behind it shows through.

color.$description: A step's fill. None at rest: it is where hover, focus and press are drawn on a pressable step.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: The marker of this condition is a ring with no fill.

color.$description: The marker of a step with an error: no fill, a ring in the error color.
The ring of a step with an error.
The glyph priority_high in a step with an error.
The label of a step with an error.
The description of a step with an error: often what the error is.
The color hover, focus and press mix into a pressable step's container: its label's.

state-duration.$description: How long a step's colors take to change between states and conditions.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple: the pressed layer grows from the point of contact over this time, with state-easing. Unused by the other choices.
